tagline: Our web app lets users connect an Ethereum wallet via WalletConnect, Privy, or Coinbase Wallet to fetch on-chain data. Indexed with **The Graph** and processed by an AI engine, it generates insightful, data-driven reports on wallet activity and trends.
description: We are Ethereum wallet integration via WalletConnect, Privy, or Coinbase Wallet, enabling automatic retrieval of on-chain transaction data. This data is indexed using The Graph for efficient querying and structured storage. An AI-powered analytics engine then processes the indexed blockchain data, generating actionable insights and detailed reports on wallet activity, transaction patterns, and network trends.
how_its_made: Our project is built using **React.js** for a dynamic and efficient UI, styled with **Tailwind CSS** for a responsive, utility-first design. We integrate **WalletConnect, Privy, and Coinbase Wallet** to enable seamless Ethereum wallet connections, allowing real-time retrieval of on-chain transaction data. This data is indexed using **The Graph**, ensuring efficient querying and structured storage, and then processed through an **AI-driven analytics engine** to generate actionable insights. Blockchain interactions are handled using **ethers.js**, enabling secure and efficient communication with smart contracts. The combination of these technologies ensures a seamless, high-performance user experience with deep blockchain analytics.
